The '''Virgillian Free Alignment''' was a resistance group that fought against the ruling autocratic government of the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]] known as the [[Aristocracy]] during the [[Virgillian Civil War]] from [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]]. When the Aristocracy aligned itself with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Virgillian Free Alignment fought alongside the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], who fought the Empire's reign throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. While the Aristocracy held control of all [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology in the [[star system/Legends|system]], the Free Alignment relied on comparatively primitive weapons including [[flintlock]]s and clubs until the Alliance provided blasters and [[Starship/Legends|starships]], including the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser]] ''[[Flurry]]''.

As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] progressed, the Empire deemed the Virgillia system to be of sufficiently low value as to remove withdraw their forces, leaving the Aristocracy exposed. This would result in the Free Alignment achieve victory in the system shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], where they provided twenty-two warships in support of their Alliance compatriots.

==Description==
[[File:C-73tracker.jpg|thumb|left|270px|The Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet included C-73 Tracker starfighters.]]
At some point before [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]],<ref name="HNN date 23" /> the Virgillian Free Alignment was formed as a resistance group against the autocratic government of the [[Virgillia system/Legends|Virgillia system]], the [[Aristocracy]]. As well as being anti-Aristocracy, once the Aristocracy aligned itself with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], they also fought against Imperials. It was confined to the [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of the system; [[Virgillia 7]], in particular, was a hotbed of Free Alignment activity from the beginning of the [[Virgillian Civil War]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

For much of the war, the Aristocracy controlled all [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] technology in the system, and as a result, the Free Alignment frequently fought using [[flintlock]]s, clubs and even their bare hands. After the beginning of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] supplied them with [[Weapon/Legends|weaponry]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]], supplementing the tiny and antiquated [[Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet]]. At the end of the war, the Free Alignment had [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[Zebra starfighter]]s, [[C-73 Tracker starfighter]]s, at least twenty [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], and eight [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers]]. The cruisers were donated by the Alliance in the last weeks of the war, and they were instrumental in the Free Alignment victory. By capturing Imperial ships, the Free Alignment was able to upgrade their ships considerably: four of their cruiser-carriers were upgraded with sensors, shields, weapons and computers; and their flagship, the ''[[Flurry]]'', received even more upgrades,<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> including a slow-to-connect [[HoloNet transceiver/Legends|HoloNet transceiver]] which was able to access the Imperial [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].<ref name="Bakura novel">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

Despite the limitations imposed by the Aristocracy, the Free Alignment had several members who were particularly skilled. [[Tessa Manchisco]] was a talented [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Navigator/Legends|navigator]] who had an inborn insight into capital ship engagements, and was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Free Alignment Starfleet. [[Rannd Delckis]], who defected from the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] late in the war, was trained at an [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] as a [[Communications officer/Legends|communications officer]] and used those skills to great effect as the communications officer aboard the ''Flurry''. He was an expert at using and confusing Imperial sensors and the HoloNet. [[Monnda Tebbo]] was a Rebel Alliance member who became a Free Alignment fighter when he was sent by the Alliance as an expert in operating the ''Flurry''. He was a master of [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] and piloting, and had extensive experience in both Rebel and Imperial ships. He passed his expertise in [[Space warfare/Legends|space combat]] onto the [[Virgillian]]s, and was so important in securing victory that he was given honorary Virgillian citizenship.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==History==
[[File:Flurry_crew.png|thumb|right|200px|Free Alignment members Tessa Manchisco, Monnda Tebbo and Rannd Delckis]]
In 25 BBY, the Virgillian Civil War broke out between the Free Alignment and the Aristocracy. In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] was [[Mission to Virgillia 7|sent]] to negotiate peace, but their ship was destroyed upon arrival.<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|jediwatch/13228_1.html|Virgillian Jedi Envoy Declared Lost}}</ref> After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Declaration of a New Order|fell]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the Aristocracy aligned itself with the Galactic Empire. After this, the Free Alignment was hunted by the Imperial Navy, which patrolled the system, and fought against [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Despite their lack of blasters, they successfully used unorthodox tactics to win engagements.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

In Tessa Manchisco's youth, her [[Parent/Legends|parents]] were leaders of the Free Alignment on Virgillia 7 until their [[Death/Legends|execution]] by stormtroopers during a raid on their home. Manchisco went on to be one of the first pilots in the Virgillian Free Alignment Starfleet and quickly became a commanding officer. She assisted in the transformation of the Free Alignment from a [[Guerrilla warfare/Legends|guerrilla]] group into a military force.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

The Rebel Alliance began to send ships and blasters to the Free Alignment after the start of the Galactic Civil War. They also offered to send troops, although the Free Alignment declined, preferring to use only Virgillians. Shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and weeks before Monnda Tebbo joined the Alignment, Rannd Delckis entered the Imperial Navy as an ensign. His parents were Aristocracy, but his first mission, in which he witnessed a massacre of refugees by stormtroopers, led to his defection to the Free Alignment. While the group was initially sceptical, as this was the first time one of their enemies had defected, Delckis earned their trust and became a valued part of the group. His training at the Imperial Academy meant that he was able to confuse Imperial communications systems, and he received two commendations for his work.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

[[File:Flurryandx-wing.png|thumb|left|270px|The Virgillian Free Alignment's flagship, the ''Flurry'', operating as part of the Rebel Alliance fleet after the end of the Virgillian Civil War]]
Weeks before the end of the Virgillian Civil War, the Rebel Alliance delivered eight ''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruisers to the Free Alignment. Despite the Virgillians' prior refusal of troops, the Rebel navigator Monnda Tebbo accompanied the ships, as the ships were so unusual that the Rebel Alliance considered it necessary to send an advisor. As well as teaching the Virgillians how to operate the cruisers, Tebbo taught them advanced navigation and space combat.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

As the Galactic Civil War escalated, the Empire withdrew from the system; due to its remoteness, it was no longer a priority. They only left the Aristocracy their outdated ships, and using Tebbo's techniques, the Free Alignment captured all the Imperial vessels in the system. They improved their cruisers with captured Imperial technology, and the combination of the Imperial retreat, the cruisers and Tebbo's education led to the Free Alignment winning the war shortly before the Battle of Endor<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Endor">''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'' states that the Free Alignment won the war a short time before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref>

After their victory, the Virgillian Free Alignment, in gratitude for the Alliance's assistance during the Virgillian Civil War, sent what forces it could spare to the [[Alliance Military/Legends|Alliance Military]] massing near<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" /> the planet<ref name="Newest Rebels">{{WEGCite|book=The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook|story=Newest Rebels}}</ref> [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], including twenty-two warships, for the Battle of Endor.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Members==
Members of the Free Alignment included Tessa Manchisco's parents, Tessa Manchisco, Rannd Delckis, Monnda Tebbo, and the pilot [[Valtis]]. They also had at least twenty-three pilots, including Valtis.<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />

==Behind the scenes==
Several members of the Free Alignment first appeared in ''[[The Truce at Bakura]]'', a novel by [[Kathy Tyers]] which was published by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[1993]].<ref name="Bakura novel" /> The group was first identified by name in ''[[The Truce at Bakura Sourcebook]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] guide published in [[1996]] by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book was written by Kathy Tyers and [[Eric S. Trautmann]].<ref name="Bakura Sourcebook" />
